title: 'Kanan-sama wa Akumade Choroi' Second Season in Production
content: The 12th and final episode of Kanan-sama wa Akumade Choroi ( Mistress Kanan is Devilishly Easy ) ended with an announcement on Sunday that a second season is in production. The official website also revealed a commemorative illustration drawn by character designer Akari Minagawa (pictured right).
author: MyAnimeList

title: 'Akane-banashi' Second Season Announced for Winter 2027
content: The 12th and final episode of Akane-banashi ended with a second season announcement on Saturday, scheduled to air on the IMAnimation programming block on TV Asahi's 24 affiliate stations and BS Asahi in January 2027. The official website also announced six supporting cast that appeared in the final episode.

title: Akane-banashi Season 2 Announced for January 2027
content: Akane-banashi Season 2 anime has been officially announced following the finale of the first season. It is set to premiere in January 2027. A new teaser trailer and voice cast were also announced.
author: Anime Corner

title: Akane-banashi Anime Gets 2nd Season in January 2027
content: TV Asahi announced on Saturday that the television anime of writer Yūki Suenaga and illustrator Takamasa Moue 's Akane-banashi manga will get a second season that will debut in January 2027. The first season ended on Saturday with the conclusion of the show's Karaku Cup Arc.
author: ANN
